apex-logistics.content: [Discovery Call (Call 1) - Date: 2026-09-02] Initial meeting with Sarah Jenkins (CFO) and Mike Ramirez (VP of Operations). Their legacy dispatch system causes 4-hour routing delays per day. CRITICAL OBJECTION: Sarah stated they have an ironclad budget freeze until Q4. She explicitly said: 'We cannot commit to upfront annual contracts right now, any deal requiring immediate cash outlay will be vetoed by the board.'

[Technical Evaluation (Call 2) - Date: 2026-09-14] Met Dave Miller (Lead Solutions Architect) and Engineering team. Their current stack runs on Amazon EKS (Kubernetes) and self-hosted PostgreSQL. Dave's major concern is proprietary vendor lock-in; he refuses black-box SaaS without open APIs. COMPETITOR ALERT: Dave disclosed that CloudX sent a $15,000 quote yesterday and offered free migration help. However, CloudX's API has rate-limiting issues Dave dislikes.

[Security & Architecture Review (Call 3) - Date: 2026-09-22] Compliance sync with Elena Rostova (Chief Information Security Officer). Security requirements: SOC-2 Type II certificate, encrypted backups, and SSO (Okta integration). Mike mentioned off the record that their team loves our workflow, but reminded us: 'Sarah will kill this deal next Monday unless we give them deferred Q4 billing and beat CloudX on migration.'

fintech-global.content: [Discovery (Call 1) - Date: 2026-09-05] Met with Alex Vance (Head of Payments). High chargeback rates on international card processing. Strict requirement: API response times must be strictly under 45ms. Alex got burned by their previous vendor whose service crashed during Black Friday.

[Competitive Bake-off (Call 2) - Date: 2026-09-18] Alex revealed they are actively testing Stripe Radar and DataVisor. DataVisor offered a 20% discount on transaction volume. Alex expressed frustration with DataVisor's false-positive rate blocking legitimate customers.
